cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
cl.x: SikaQuick®-2500 AU is a 1- part, cementitious, very rapid hardening, early strength gain concrete repair material.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer

s: On, above and below grade on concrete
Highway overlays and repairs
Structural repair material for concrete roadways, parking structures, bridges, dams and ramps
Full depth patching repairs
Economical patching material for horizontal repairs of concrete and mortar

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet pages 2-3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality / Pre-Treatment > Concrete
s: Surface must be clean and sound. Remove all deteriorated concrete, dirt, oil, grease, and other bond-inhibiting materials from the area to be repaired. Be sure repair area is not less than 5 mm deep. Preparation work should be done by appropriate mechanical techniques.

Obtain an exposed aggregate surface with a minimum surface profile of 3 mm (CSP 6) on clean, sound concrete. To ensure optimum repair results, the effectiveness of decontamination and preparation should be assessed by a pull-off test. Saw cutting of edges is recommended. Saturate surface to be repaired with clean water. Substrate should be saturated surface dry (SSD) prior to application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality / Pre-Treatment > Steel reinforcement
cl.x: Rust, scale, mortar, concrete, dust and other loose and deleterious material which reduces bond or contributes to corrosion shall be removed. Surfaces shall be prepared using abrasive blast cleaning techniques or high pressure water-blasting to achieve a bright metal finish.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information
s: Mixing ratio: 2.1 – 2.4 litres of water per 20 kg bag
Yield: 10 litres per 20 kg bag
Pot Life: Approximately 15 minutes after adding powder to the water
Initial set time: ~ 15 - 20 minutes at 23 °C / 50 % r.h. (AS/NZS 2350.4-2006)
Final set time: ~ 25 - 30 minutes at 23 °C / 50 % r.h. (AS/NZS 2350.4-2006)
r: 2.1 – 2.4 litres of water per 20 kg bag
Approximately 15 minutes after adding powder to the water

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Mixing
cl.x: Mechanically mix in an appropriately sized mortar mixer. Wet down all tools and mixer to be used. Start with 2.1 litres of water added to the mixing vessel. Add 1 bag of SikaQuick®-2500 AU while continuing to mix. Add up to another 0.3 litres of water to achieve desired consistency. Do not over water.

cl.t: Application - Reinforcement Corrosion Protection / Primer Coating
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application > Reinforcement Corrosion Protection / Primer Coating
cl.x: Where a reinforcement coating is required, apply to the whole exposed circumference of the steel the SikaTop-110 EpoCem or Sika Monotop-910N. The repair mortar must be applied into the coating ‘wet’ on ‘dry’.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application > Concrete Bonding Primer
cl.x: Prime the prepared substrate with a scrub coat of SikaQuick®-2500 AU by firmly scraping the scrub coat over the substrate surface to form a thin layer and fill any pores or cavities in the surface. Ensure the whole surface to be repaired is covered by the scrub coat. The repair mortar has to be applied into primer ‘wet’ on ‘wet’.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application > Repair Mortar
cl.x: The prepared mortar must be scrubbed into the substrate. Be sure to fill all pores and voids. force materials against the edge of the repair, working towards the centre. After filling the repair, screed of excess. Allow concrete to set to desired stiffness, then finish. If a smoother finish is desired, a magnesium float should be used. Mixing, placing and finishing should not exceed 15 minutes maximum. To control setting times, cold water should be used in hot weather and hot water used in cold weather.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Curing Treatment
cl.x: Moist cure should commence immediately after finishing. It is necessary to protect newly applied material from rain. To prevent from freezing, cover with insulating material.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be mechanically removed.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Important Considerations
s: Apply only to sound, prepared substrate.
Avoid application in direct sun and/or strong winds.
Do not feather edge.
Use only potable water.
Variations in aggregates may produce differences in strengths from the typical values stated in Product Data Sheet.
For early application of epoxy coatings. On site testing is recommended for verification. Consult coatings manufacturer for advice.
